You are an astronaut on Mount Sharp

The ground is real NASA HiRISE terrain. Walk with W A S D or the arrow keys, drag to look around, V switches first / third person.

The tablet in your hands is Martian Map. Idle, it shows a compass and how dangerous the ground is. Press Tab or M to raise it.

Choose a science stop or tap the map to set a destination. Compare the available routes, then start EVA. During the walk, use manual controls or Autopilot; the mission panel also provides return, beacon and simulation controls.

Everything runs inside this browser — no network link to Earth needed.
